Daily AI news + real executive strategy

caption:
Swipe for 4 moves your board needs today. Nvidia's CEO declared AGI arrived, and every week you wait compounds the gap. 📈

Move 1 is the freeze, stopping cognitive hires while competitors keep posting; Move 2 is the redirect, converting one analyst's $80,000 salary into 330 AI seats for a year; Move 3 is the audit, finding your three most expensive cognitive processes and automating those first; Move 4 is the moat, training AI on your proprietary data for 12 months before a competitor makes that advantage impossible to replicate.

Jensen's declaration is backed by physical reality: 90 US data centers now carry over 100 megawatts each, a number tripling by 2030. Executives who treat today as the starting gun own the cost structure that wins the next decade.
Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this means for yours.

Sources: Nvidia, US AI infrastructure data

#AI #CEO #artificialintelligence #businessstrategy #futureofwork
pinned_comment: Which move is your business furthest behind on? Most founders I talk to skip Move 3 entirely and wonder later why Move 4 never sticks.

candidates: THE JENSEN DECLARATION: 4 MOVES YOUR BOARD NEEDS
THE AGI ARRIVAL PROTOCOL: 4 MOVES FOR CEOS
THE 4-MOVE CAPITAL WINDOW AGI JUST OPENED
hook_tournament.why: 'JUST OPENED' hits like breaking news and creates urgency—you pause to understand. 'PROTOCOL' is just corporate advice; nobody clicks that at 2am.

candidates: ONE SALARY FUNDS 330 AI SEATS. 4 MOVES MOST COMPANIES HAVEN'T MADE YET
MOST COMPANIES STILL PAY 333X TOO MUCH FOR ANALYSIS. THESE 4 AI MOVES END THAT
YOUR ANALYST COSTS 333X MORE THAN AI. 4 MOVES TO CLOSE THAT GAP THIS YEAR
hook_sharpen.why: [2] makes it personal ('YOUR ANALYST') and adds urgency ('THIS YEAR'), creating immediate alarm. [1] uses the same shock number but stays abstract ('MOST COMPANIES'), so it lands as business commentary, not a direct threat.
